items.description: Verify function signature matches API specification
items.expected_behavior: Function schedule_tasks accepts list[str] tasks and list[tuple[str, str]] dependencies, returns list[str]

items.description: Test circular dependency raises ValueError
items.expected_behavior: Raises ValueError when circular dependency is detected

items.description: Test tasks parameter is not a list raises TypeError
items.expected_behavior: Raises TypeError when tasks is not a list

items.description: Test dependencies parameter is not a list raises TypeError
items.expected_behavior: Raises TypeError when dependencies is not a list

items.description: Test task name is not a string raises TypeError
items.expected_behavior: Raises TypeError when any task name is not a string

items.description: Test dependency pair is not a tuple of strings raises TypeError
items.expected_behavior: Raises TypeError when dependency is not a pair of strings

items.description: Test case sensitivity of task names
items.expected_behavior: Task names are treated as case-sensitive; 'Task' and 'task' are different tasks

items.description: Test function does not execute tasks or modify external state
items.expected_behavior: Function returns ordering only without executing tasks or touching files

items.description: Test every task appears exactly once in output
items.expected_behavior: All tasks from input appear exactly once in returned list

items.description: Test deterministic output on repeated calls
items.expected_behavior: Multiple calls with same inputs return identical output

items.description: Test long dependency chain with many tasks
items.expected_behavior: Correctly orders long linear chain respecting all dependencies

items.description: Test linear dependency chain execution order
items.expected_behavior: Returns tasks in dependency order: fetch_data -> clean_data -> train_model -> evaluate_model

items.description: Test complex graph with multiple paths and convergence points
items.expected_behavior: Returns valid topological sort respecting all dependency constraints

items.description: Test lexicographic ordering when no dependencies exist
items.expected_behavior: Returns tasks in descending lexicographic order: [c, b, a]

items.description: Test single task with no dependencies
items.expected_behavior: Returns list containing only the single task

items.description: Test empty tasks and dependencies
items.expected_behavior: Returns empty list

items.description: Test diamond-shaped dependency graph
items.expected_behavior: Returns [a, b, c, d] where a precedes b and c, and both b and c precede d

items.description: Test multiple independent dependency chains
items.expected_behavior: Returns deterministic ordering respecting all dependencies and using lexicographic ordering for available tasks

items.description: Test duplicate task names raises ValueError
items.expected_behavior: Raises ValueError with message indicating duplicate task names

items.description: Test dependency references unknown task raises ValueError
items.expected_behavior: Raises ValueError when dependency refers to task not in tasks list

summary: Comprehensive test plan for task scheduler module covering API shape, normal behavior, edge cases, error handling, and boundary conditions.
